cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(fsqlf_dll)

# Find Flex
find_package(FLEX)

if(NOT FLEX_FOUND)
    message(STATUS "Flex not found, using pre-generated lexer if available")
endif()

# Generate lexer if Flex is available
if(FLEX_FOUND)
    FLEX_TARGET(fsqlf_lexer 
        lib_fsqlf/formatter/fsqlf.lex 
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lex.yy.c
    )
    set(LEXER_SOURCE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lex.yy.c)
else()
    # Use pre-generated file if it exists
    if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib_fsqlf/formatter/lex.yy.c)
        set(LEXER_SOURCE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib_fsqlf/formatter/lex.yy.c)
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Neither Flex nor pre-generated lexer found")
    endif()
endif()

# Source files
set(SOURCES
    dll_wrapper.c
    ${LEXER_SOURCE}
    lib_fsqlf/formatter/lex_wrapper.c
    lib_fsqlf/formatter/print_keywords.c
    lib_fsqlf/formatter/tokque.c
    lib_fsqlf/conf_file/conf_file_create.c
    lib_fsqlf/conf_file/conf_file_read.c
    lib_fsqlf/kw/kw.c
    lib_fsqlf/kw/kwmap.c
    lib_fsqlf/kw/is_word.c
    lib_fsqlf/lex/token.c
    utils/queue/queue.c
    utils/stack/stack.c
    utils/string/read_int.c
)

# Create DLL
add_library(fsqlf SHARED ${SOURCES})

# Set properties
set_target_properties(fsqlf PROPERTIES
    WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON
    PREFIX ""
)

# Include directories
target_include_directories(fsqlf PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib_fsqlf
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/utils
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
)

# Compiler definitions
target_compile_definitions(fsqlf PRIVATE
    BUILDING_LIBFSQLF
    _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
)

# Install
install(TARGETS fsqlf
    RUNTIME DESTINATION bin
    LIBRARY DESTINATION lib
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib
)
